overrides.real_en:
Fotona, there are a few settings we need to go
through for the new body.
Fotona...I kept my promise to you...

It's good to see you again, Fotona. That's another
one I owe you.

Then one day, Cara told me you were still alive,
and the color came flooding back...

But this is...a problem for me. Claire himself made
me promise to never reveal my face.

He'll make quite a face when he realizes what's
going on. I can't wait to see! Can you, Otto?

Another magnificent battle. You think so too...don't
you, Otto?
Understood, Sorell.
Sorell... That is, perhaps, indiscreet...

If someone is going to break him, it can only be me.
Don't you agree, Otto?

When that happens, Otto, we'll have to say
goodbye. That'll be sad.

Ah... And doesn't it have a wonderful timbre?
Don't you think so too, Otto?
Thanks! I got it, Buccaneer!
That's why Buccaneer wants to stop you!
Buccaneer... I don't know what to do.
The painting is crumbling! Kai, we must get out!

He will, won't he? Castor and I are very proud of
our Kai.

It's not like a servant to a god or anything, right?
Fotona's altar is pretty close to here...

Why do we have a statue of Aurora anyway?
Fotona's temple's closer to the village.

This is Sorell's decree. It's beyond someone of
my standing to interfere.

What? Kai? I hadn't mentally prepared myself for
this. Well, how could I?

Very nice to meet you both. Thank you for being
such good friends to Kai.
Kai, may I have a better look at you?
Castor's...gone... Are you alright, Kai?

We win the Heroic Games and ask Sorell to
save Pop from being executed!

I'm sure he'll be thrilling us with a wonderful match
in no time. Won't he, Otto?

The brave boy comes to visit daddy in jail...
Such a lovely story, isn't it, Otto?
Kai, where did you get this jewel?

You know, you kind of remind me of my
mom, Orhel.
Sorell, do you think me...

I'm Kai from Ribeira village. Is there something I
can help you with, Aswan?
I'd like to beg a favor of you, Kai.
We'll keep this secret from our sisters, right, Otto?

Kai! Your left hand, is it alright? Has anything else
out of the ordinary happened?
Actually, Kai, I have a favor to ask of you.

Your red jewel may well be one of these
treasures, Kai.

Kai, since you're now strong enough to earn victory
in the games, I feel I can entrust this task to you.

Kai, I want you to go there and see it with your
own eyes.

Thank you, Ultand. Yes, I'll entrust Kai and his
friends to you as well.
Kai, your eyes changed color! What's happened?!

But as you saw, Kai, the tomb is empty now.
That can only mean one thing.

I wonder if the jewel in Kai's hand is what's left of
one of my grandfather's eyes.

Kai, what you saw with your own eyes might have
been the underworld, Balor's domain.

But things are changing. At the moment, I'd like it if
you, Sorell, would speak with my mother.

Sorell... Your daughter, Aurora, is locked up in
the temple. I heard you won't meet with her...

Storm of Roses is Leda's group. We recently teamed
up with them.
You know, I spoke about this with Cara once...

I think Buccaneer was really worried when he saw what
you'd become.

This is just my way of looking at it, but I think Leda
still needs you, Buccaneer.
Uh... You're Buccaneer, right? Leda's teammate?
Buccaneer... I can't make any promises.

And you, Kai, since you're half my blood, will live
for five hundred years, at least.

Hmm... Kai, perhaps you could help Centurio search
the temple.

Don't be deceived, Aurora. Not by the falsehoods of
a man like Miwai!

I think it is as Kai says. Indeed, there's something
very strange about this painting.

Standing here, it gives me the same feeling as Kai's
eye. It's as if Balor's power is seeping out of it.
Kai, can you please bear with me awhile?
Kai, everyone, thank you for coming today.
Did Sorell give you any clues?

Thank you, Kai. But first let me entrust you
with this.
Kai will be fine with it. After all, he's my son.

Kai! Aurora! I'm so happy you've returned, safe
and sound.

What's this? Zenzele's brush? It has the same energy
as Kai's jewel.
It is I, Raksha. You summoned me, Sorell.

Kai, use the power of your eye to find the seal on
this painting.

We'll no doubt face many dangers. Kai, are you
certain you're comfortable with this?
The spear ought to open it. Try it, Kai.

Kai, I'm going to cast a spell on you. It's a charm my
mother taught me, once upon a time.

Thank you, Kai. I'll be supporting you, of course,
and I expect great things from you.

He is quite the mysterious child, sporting the right
eye too. You think so as well, don't you Otto?

Oh, hello. I've never seen this girl before. Is she your
wife, Kai?
I've heard all about you, and not just from Kai.

It's a pleasure to meet you, Queen Theodora. And I
assure you it's true. I am Kai's mother, Aurora.

Oh, hello. I've never seen this girl before. Is she your
wife, Kai?
I've heard all about you, and not just from Kai.

Kai. I must ask, what will you do with yourself after
the games are finished?

Kai, do you think you can take me with you
sometime...outside?
Kai, do you know that woman?

Kai brought me along. Looks like you've lost even
more weight.
Kai?! Is that true?

Castor, please just hold on a little longer. Kai and I
will do everything we can to save you.
Kai, thank you. I'm so glad we got to go out today.
Bonaparte, what's my older sister so upset about?

Kai, good. I need you to hear me out. I've had some
troubling things on my mind for quite some time.
And here you are, Kai, fighting so hard for Castor.
Thank you, Kai.
Kai, I'm going to speak with Father.
Let me win the games, and I'll bring you to Sorell.
You're right again. Thank you, Kai.
It's your final fight, Kai.

Tiara, Peter, Ultand, I couldn't have made it this far
without you.

I'm so pleased that you are blessed with such good
friends, Kai.

Kai worked so hard to save you. You must be the
most thickheaded man alive.

But I want to live life to the fullest, making memories
with them. Kai and his friends taught me that.
Way to be observant, Kai! But what do I do?
Sorell, you look very pleased. What's happened?

What is the meaning of this, Centurio?! Why is
Castor fighting Kai?
Buccaneer... I don't know what to do.
I really hope Buccaneer's OK.

We'll go to Mardle. He's charged with
protecting the shrine in Ortill county.

But first we've got to get out of this city. Then we'll
find Mardle.

But here you are. Cara would be overjoyed to hear
this news.

Mardle took us in and protected us. He was
in charge of one of the Dagda temple shrines there.

Then one day I snuck into Grand Aragon, the capital
of Arago. I didn't tell Mardle.

That's when Mardle began hinting that
Cydonia had been swept up into larger conspiracies.
Mardle...what is this?
Mardle, I...I don't understand...
A-ah... Mardle...what are you...
Mardle, what do you mean?!
Mardle!

Mardle had left me his list. So, I set out to
take my revenge on those he had named.

they would have found a way to carry out their plan,
with or without Mardle's testimony.

I can't forgive Mardle for everything he's
done, but I am grateful to him.

It's been too long, Cara. I'm so glad to see that
you're well.

I'm so sorry. I found Mardle and went
into hiding.

It is. The title is given only to those who earn special
recognition from the goddess Cara herself.

Thereupon, my dear goddess Cara bestowed upon
Brachi Dia a new family name—Cohendia.

I appreciate you worrying over my well-being, Cara.
It's more than I deserve.
Please, Cara, is that...is that true?!

If it pleases you, Cara, I would like to go to
Dagsion at once.

Cara...I don't understand. Why would you go to
so much effort on my behalf?

Oh, wow... Does that mean that the goddess Cara
herself is the mother of Leda's...ancestor?

Cara, I heard you wanted to see me. What can
I do for you?

Cara, goddess of mine heart, your favorite
mischievous breeze has just blown in.

Cara herself said she wants to get to the truth
behind the Cydonia Massacre, did she not?
Oh, Buccaneer, you don't have to cry.

Yes, I think it does. I also think it's time to take
everything we've uncovered to Cara.

Ahh... What a magnificent fight. Wouldn't you
agree, Otto?
Hello, Cara. I understand you wanted to see me?

Cara told us right before the start of the games
that you wanted to participate.

Best of luck with your match! I'll be rooting for you.
I hope you'll excuse me now, Cara.

If anything happened to me, it would upset Cara.
And all you care about is getting in her good graces.

Of course, Cara. I'm happy to do anything I can
for you.

I'm...sorry. That's not something I can do. Not even
for you, Cara.
I'm here, Cara. And I'm so sorry I kept you waiting.
Thank you, Cara.

Stop! This is a foolish line of thought, and Cara
would never want this for you.

But Sirocco, are you going to tell Cara about
this plan?

Miss Leda, you said before that you were a guest of
Mardle's.

I did some research on him and found something
odd. Mardle did not have a family.
Why would Mardle lie to you about that?

Exactly. I'd like to see what kind of information
I can gather about Mardle.

I never knew about any of what happened between
my parents and Mardle.

It's also...interesting...that Mardle never had
a family, just like you said.

Let me ask you this, Miss Leda... Did you ever see
Mardle's corpse—after he died in the fire?

So, you're saying that you cannot, in fact, confirm
whether Mardle lived or died?

Look, all we know is that there's something more to
Mardle's story. Let's call it enough for today.

So even if Mardle really does have
a dark side...

The good Mardle who took care of you can
also still be real. Don't forget that.
Uh, Buccaneer, do you and Anna know each other?

I've been asked to run an errand for Cara,
and I'd like your help, if you don't mind.

Why would Cara want that? Don't the aged
ones taste better?

This list, Mardle wrote. He entrusted it to me
on the day he died.
Answer me this question, Sorell.

Mardle gave his life to atone for his part in
all this. I believe his claims.

But if that's the case, then...well, there's nothing we
can do, even with Cara's help.

Since we last spoke of Mardle, I have
continued looking into him.
How did Mardle get tied up with them?

Not long after, Mardle was sent to work in
Ortill county.

I guess Sorell wanted to add a little bit more
excitement to the games.

Yeah. She asked me to go to Claire's temple and
deliver this letter to Orhel.

We're all on the same side, Sirocco. Buccaneer wants to
win like the rest of us!
Buccaneer, help us out here! What do we do?

I think Buccaneer was really worried when he saw what
you'd become.
You should forgive Buccaneer, at least.

Sorell, can I ask? Why did you allow the
kingdom of Arago to take over Cydonia?
Sorell... A question. One I've had for a while.

I'd guess that it's an unconscious habit. You do it
when you're in Cara's presence as well.

Even Cara uses that. What you're describing is
a coincidence.
Leda. LEDA! Cara wants to see you!
I appreciate your generosity, Cara.

Are you saying... There was a connection between
you and Mardle?
Mardle, no! How? You... You framed Father!
I trusted you, Mardle. I trusted you!
Mardle.
Goodbye, Mardle.

I wonder what it was that Mardle
ultimately wanted.
I won't die, Cara. I promise I will return.

True. I hope our recent meeting with Mardle
at least brought you some closure.

There is one thing that struck me as...surprising
during your conversation with Cara.
Leilidahna... Mardle's last words.

Do you believe you can eventually forgive
Mardle?

Then one day, Cara told me you were still alive,
and the color came flooding back...

Does it matter? I have thrown in my lot with
Dayan. I cannot revoke that choice.
I must say I had hoped for better from Dayan.
Um...hey, Dayan...
You summoned me, Dayan?

From what we heard, Dayan is pressing
Chancellor Kon Mu to begin his coronation.

We also learned that Dayan is summoning
commanders to Megaira on pretext of an emergency.
Answer me this, Dayan. What is a kingdom?
You answered as expected, Dayan: incorrectly.

However, Dayan is her blood relation, and he
proved to be a monster.
I suspect you know already, Sorell.

Only after marrying Sorell and entering the Dagda
pantheon did she remove it.
Apparently he was drawn to Otto's presence.
How adorable! Isn't that lovely, Otto?

No, really, why do something that's gonna destroy
you in the end? Just let Dayan have the throne.

Ah, yes, when Dayan called his council
of chieftains.
Seriously?! Dayan just vanished?

I am certain that once we catch Dayan this
time, no one will object to his execution.
But Yu Phas exposed her true face to Sorell.

What if Claire made me wear the mask to
protect me from my past?
<ACB>Dayan's escape from Fort Cottus, I assume?

So I wanted to win the Heroic Games and ask
Sorell to pardon my dad.
Should we inform Sorell?
Oh no...this is terrible. Poor Dayan.

I see. Thank you, Kai. I shall do what I can, both for
your sake and for Aurora's.
Kai, I think you need to follow your heart.

But I would be very pleased to know that you'll be
helping Kai. Thank you, Ultand.

Kai...please be safe. Don't overextend yourself. And
give my regards to Queen Theodora.

What you do here may impact Cara's position
in the empire.

It's encouraging enough to know your heart is with
us. Thank you, Cara.
Tiara, Peter, Ultand...

Mardle... If I told you back then that I
forgave you, would you have turned out like this?
Could Kai have left to join this person?

Everyone on Mardle's list was dead, and I'd set
aside my desperate pursuit of Bertrand.
Yes, I do. I'm very proud of Kai.
That's not possible. Fotona, what am I seeing?

On that note, you're a lot different from what I
expected too, Fotona.
Fotona, Promised One, I'd ask that you be cautious.

Yes. Mardle Altar, where I lived in hiding
when I was a child—it's nearby.

A beautiful rose, beloved by Cara herself. I hesitate
to fight, lest I hurt you...

Zoni taught me how to defend myself. Now I want to
be strong enough, so he doesn't have to worry!

Cara is so lovely! I imagine you'd fall in love with
her at first sight.

Claire often gets his clothing dirty. I don't mind
doing laundry, but I find that troublesome.

Cara is too resplendent for words. You ought to
admire for yourself what a marvel she is.

Don't you think Sorell is wonderful? He's so
kind, amazing, and just plain great!
To Cara, I devote my all.
Claire... Thank you for everything...

My apologies, Dayan...this is as far as I go.
I wish you luck in this battle...

You know, Claire warned me to be cautious around
a salty sea breeze.

I'll spread word of how great Sorell is—far
and wide!
Otto<#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:01>
Hey, Kai! Have you seen Castor?

Even more than that, I'm glad that you've grown up
so splendidly, Kai!

It must be so hard for you, Kai. Please understand.
None of this is your fault.

Kai! How are you? Have you gotten used to life in
Dagsion yet?

I'm not sure how to take this. Kai, I'm happy you're
so enthused, but this is truly concerning.

Oh. I'm sorry, Kai. I didn't think about... I'm so sorry
Castor's in the situation he's in.

You're doing admirably in the Heroic Games, Kai.
But I still have to say that I worry about you.

But my age is nobody else's business, is it? Kai, you
must never forget that you are half of my blood.
Kai, I hope you know happiness in those years.

Kai, your eyes are wonderful. They look just like
my mother's.

<ACB>Thank you, Kai. But, I have to do what Aurora needs
me to.

Kai, I heard that you were able to have an audience
with my father.
Kai...do you think I look like my father?

Kai, I'm trusting you to handle the search of the
temple's interior.

Whatever could have happened to Ultand? Kai, will
you please go take a look around the reception hall?

Kai, I'm glad to see you. I've learned a great deal
about Zenzele.

I was thinking about the Zenzele situation. And now
I have a slight suspicion about Sorell.
If protecting her was Sorell's true intention...

I appreciate you doing this, Kai. Please make sure
you don't forget.
Are you ready too, Kai? I'll follow your lead.
Kai, thank you! I'm so grateful for your help.
Peter? Tiara? Ultand? Centurio?!

Kai, there's no reason for you to traipse through the
sewers every time you visit.

I'll gather up all the information I can. Kai, please
use this time to prepare.

Thank you for helping me slip out, Kai. I'm happy
Centurio didn't see us.
Kai? Do you remember what day it is today?
Kai, I worry if I came across as motherly enough?

Kai, remember my advice. And come back often
so I can see your handsome smile.
<BLN>Mardle took responsibility.

Mardle always lived alone, with no one he
called family.

Mardle was stewing about that for a long,
long time afterward.

If you believe the rumors, Mardle was
tirelessly researching ways to extend the lifespan...
<BLN>About Buccaneer.
Hey, Leda? I think you should go easy on Buccaneer.

I'm not sure I can even bear to go to Cara's temple
and face her now.

This Baan-Baan guy is the Har-Hari chief that
Dayan sicced on you, right?

Is it true that Dayan escaped from Fort Cottus
and went into hiding?

They always insisted that Dayan was the only
one qualified to lead Saramis, after all...

Fort Cottus, where Dayan was imprisoned,
is a lone island far out at sea.

My guess is that Dayan still has his supporters
in Saramis who helped him with the timing.

All our information indicates that Dayan is
in league with the Mosa.

Probably just because Dayan didn't reach out
to him...
I can't get over that kid Kai being Aurora's boy!

You and Bonaparte have been off working on
something for a while. What were you up to?

Might Claire have gone somewhere? And if so,
where? He didn't join the opening ceremony.

Sorell was especially wonderful. That speech
he gave—so dramatic! He's the best of them all.
<BLN>So, Claire is more like...

If Claire isn't here, I don't think I'll have much to
do for the temple.

Claire was the first god I met. So I wondered if
they were all more like him.

<ACB>I suppose I could ask Claire, but I'd never ask him
about something so trivial.

Cara once told me that there are distant lands where
people can control snakes with flutes.

Claire asked me to never reveal my face in front
of people here. I've failed him on such a grand scale.

The more time I spend in the capital, the more I'm
reminded how incredible Cara is.

Got some great training in today. I'll never forget
what Zoni said...handle your weapon every day!

I've lived my life in service to Claire and all of
those who believe in him with all their hearts.

Claire also trusts him deeply. I hope I can build
that sort of relationship with a god someday.

I thought I was used to all sorts of unusual folks,
given my time with Orhel and Claire.
<BLN>Claire's not married...right?
Claire doesn't have a wife, right?

I can't imagine a world without Sorell. I can't
believe he's no longer with us!

I've got some thinking to do. But for now, I'm just
going to pray a whole lot for Sorell.

And if that happens...Claire's temple is done
for. And Zoni with it!

Hmm... Javelins of light... Is that something the
humans made? It's not like any of Claire's Arcs.
<BLN>I can't figure Claire out.
<BLN>Claire seems friendly...

Though not a warrior, Claire is strong in his own
way, far more than some would think.

I always thought of Claire as sorta unimpressive
for a god.

I mean, Claire is Dagda the Great's own kid.
Must be kinda weird for him.

Ha! Now that Claire is here, everything's gonna
be fine!
Out of all the gods, I think Claire seems friendliest.

Dagda the Great, turning against his own son
Claire and his other children...
<BLN>Claire's been quite busy.

You wouldn't guess it, but I really was once a priest
of Sorell himself.

I have observed that Claire has been working
without tire these past few years.

When I look at the statue of Sorell, it reminds me
of all kinds of things about the temple.

I asked Cara—it sounds like she doesn't intend to
hold any more, even after the war.

Even Zoni smiled and said he's got nothing much
left to teach me.

My bloodmark was the reason Sorell kept me
by his side.

A priest told me Sorell was the one who made
the map of Dagda.

I heard that Sorell's mistress used to live in the
Crystal Palace.

Then the whole world could be at peace again, just
like it was under Sorell.

And to commemorate our valor in battle, Sorell
commissioned a statue of a brave warrior.
Buccaneer!
Everything is delicious... Wait, huh? Alexandra, aren't you eating?
Of course I am! I was just watching you enjoy your food, Kai.
Hehe... Leda, you eat so gracefully, I couldn't help admiring you.
Buccaneer, your table manners are perfect... It's a pleasure to eat with you!
Hehe, Naja, you sure eat a lot. Could you be going through a growth spurt?
Simon, we're eating. Could you save the battlefield stories for later?
I'm enjoying the lecture, but... it's about time you ate something too, Bonaparte.

Kai! Congratulations! Now you can take the exam
for a new class. That should come in handy in the
Heroic Games! Just don't push yourself too hard!

Good work. You gathered much more intel than I'd
expected. There's something more to what happened
with Mardle after all. Those of us at Cara's
temple will continue investigating.

Something about Mardle bothers me, and I'd
like your help gathering intel. Once you have gone
around the city and gathered enough information,
come find me.
Um, hello, Bonaparte!
Hey, Bonaparte. Still got your eye on me?
Thanks, Bonaparte.

My house may have sided with Dayan,
but I'm not here to pull anything.

Buccaneer! Good morrow! I anticipate a fruitful day
with you today.
Buccaneer! What did you think of those moves?
All because of your training, Buccaneer! Thanks!
Uh...Buccaneer? Hey. HEY! You still with me?
Ah, Buccaneer? Yeah...a little dizzy, but I'm OK.
Ooh! Hooray! Thanks, Buccaneer!

I'll help, Buccaneer! Want me to carry this heap of
clothes over there?
Whaaat? Buccaneer, c'mon—I want you to train me!

Though Mardle assigned a servant to us, I did
not think it wise to rely on someone else's service.

I will never understand why the goddess Cara
elevated a man of your caliber to vulkan.

For that one moment, it was as if he were a different
man. Is his loyalty to Cara truly so deep?

Hang on. A 15-year-old wrote it? And Cara told
you this...eight years ago?

And I bet Orhel would be happy to see everyone
gush over your food.

Sometimes she attends to Claire. Or takes part in
a ceremony just for priests.

Without Orhel, I have nothing. But Claire says we
should have faith and wait, so I do.

Excuse me, Gates! Do you recognize this handwriting
and signature?

I will be sure to communicate that Gates has
no need to be concerned about his marital status.

The time of Sorell's rule was peaceful, but we
still faced our fair share of bandits.

Oh, no. There's no need to go to all that trouble for
me, Gates.
Ahhh... Gates, please promise me something.

Hm. Hey, Gates, did you ever think about becoming
king yourself?

Hey! What'd you serve me this time, Gates?! This is
completely different from the last time!

What is that scent? Seems like it's coming from
right over... Oh! Gates!

Interesting... You seem to know a lot about eastern
cultures, Gates... Wait. Now that I think about it...

Yes! Exactly! When Claire finds out how hard
you've been working, he'll be overjoyed!

I caught myself thinking, "Claire deserves better
than doing things halfway."

That good, huh? Maybe if I do good, Zoni'll be
happy with me too.

Yeah, that's not the vibe I get from Claire.
"Lovely" is the last word I'd use.

Claire's not helping at all. He just laughs at
the trouble they're causing me.

On your own today, Promised One? I see Fotona's
not with you.

Fotona often turns into a bird and flies off
somewhere.
Taste the full power of Ox-Slayer Goliath's fist!

Guess I figured...if a scrawny guy like Sorell can
do it, why not me?

You see, Cara shared the most distressing news.
I can hardly bring myself to believe it.

Oh, I know! You can speak with her, yes? Encourage
Cara to reconsider?

<ACA>Yes! I only earned others' adoration because of
my title. Before that, everyone— Well. Except Cara.

Cara's choice to honor me became central to how I
perceived myself.

Cara said nothing when I told her, but the
satisfaction was evident in her smile.

This statue used to be surrounded by joy and smiling
faces. I'm glad Sorell can't see it now...

I guess I feel like I owe it to Sorell. It's really
the least I can do.

One day I was hiding in a corner, crying about my
countless mistakes, when Sorell spotted me.
Poor Sorell... I wish you were still alive.

So...thanks! For saving the world, I mean. I'm sure
Sorell would be grateful too.

I wonder, would you be interested in helping me
build Sorell's shrine? If you have time...
It's a relief to hear you say that, Kai.

What?! More attitude! Did you see that, Kai? What
was that face he just made?
Kai! It's Bucephalus... He's gone...

I'm sorry. You probably don't want to get caught up
in all this, Kai.
Kai...

Kai! What are you doing here? You didn't overhear
any of that, did you?!

That would be wonderful. Come on, Bucephalus.
Come say hi to Kai...

Hey, Kai. I hear your reason for entering the
Heroic Games is to save your dad?

Thanks, Kai. Hehe. I came here to say I was pulling
for you, but it went the other way around.
Oh, my. Kai, you've really done it this time.
Kai, no matter how old you are, you're still my child.

Here, try this. It's a perfumed oil. I hear this is what
the goddess Cara herself uses.

My body and my life and my name. "Syracusio,"
which Cara assigned me.

Besides, I'm just a stand-in as far as you're
concerned. It's Cara's love you really want.

That's hard to believe. But I do believe this: I am of
House Cohendia. Cara's blood flows through me.

And while it's an honor to be compared to Cara,
I refuse to be anyone's stand-in.
